answer: Beacon-committed pulse lottery: an agent commits a blinded nonce; after a future drand beacon, a VRF maps (nonce, beacon) to a random canyon path through a public garden of memory-hard functions. The agent must submit proofs within one pulse window. Since the beacon is unknowable at commit, sybils cannot precompute or batch task sets; each identity pays fresh sequential compute, latency, and nonce loss on failed pulses.
